title: Ashbury Rewards Programme Terms: Enrolment and Minimum Age
content:
**Clause 1 — Opening the account.** Enrolment in Ashbury Rewards is free and opens the account at Ashbury Rewards Member with no points and no night credits; the enrolment date is also the date the tier takes effect.

**Clause 2 — Minimum enrolment age.** A guest may enrol only once they have reached the minimum enrolment age of 216 whole calendar months (eighteen years). Age is counted in whole calendar months from the date of birth on the guest profile; a guest whose birthday month and day fall on the enrolment date has reached the age, and a birthday of February 29 is reached on March 1 in years without that day. The date of birth on the guest profile is the authority, read before the enrolment is made; the enrolment date may be no earlier than the day the age is reached, and that day itself qualifies.

**Clause 3 — Past stays.** Enrolling does not by itself credit any past stay; past stays are credited only under the Ashbury Rewards rules for crediting missing stays.

**Clause 4 — Linked co-brand card.** When the issuing bank has already linked an Ashbury Rewards co-brand card, the tier floor of that card applies from the enrolment date under the Ashbury Rewards elite qualification rules.

## Boundary cases on the minimum age (hypothetical dates)

| Date of birth on the profile | Enrolment date | Whole calendar months reached | Minimum age reached |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 July 2008 | 15 July 2026 | 216 | Yes — the birthday falls on the enrolment date |
| 15 July 2008 | 14 July 2026 | 215 | No |
| 29 February 2008 | 1 March 2026 | 216 | Yes — 2026 has no February 29, so the birthday is reached on March 1 |
| 29 February 2008 | 28 February 2026 | 215 | No |
| 29 February 2008 | 29 February 2028 | 240 | Yes |

## What a new account holds

| Item | At enrolment |
|---|---|
| Tier | Ashbury Rewards Member |
| Tier effective date | The enrolment date |
| Points balance | 0 |
| Elite night credits | 0 |
| Enrolment fee | None |
